background: Monmouthshire Building Society is a small mutual based in Newport, funded by retail savings from its branches in south-east Wales and the border counties and lending on residential mortgages.
synthesis: The society holds no public rating from any of the three main agencies, so a depositor has only the reported figures to go on. Capital is thin by building-society standards, with CET1 of 14.3% in the bottom quarter and leverage of 5.6% below the median. Liquidity is adequate rather than generous: LCR of 170% is in the bottom quarter while NSFR of 145% sits above the median. Nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days.
